args.brief: Chapter 3, "The Duplicate": Pema reads the handling note, then asks Eli for the missing second page. Eli brings a duplicate sheet that has arrived damp/wet at its edges. Pema dries it flat—blotter, gentle weight, no heat—before reading a word of it; Cal assists and may disagree. The wax packet stays sealed and untouched. Practical, precise actions; no one is hurt. Stop on the moment the dried page can finally be read and the team agrees to keep checking before the public demonstration.
